summary: Vodafone Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a TR-1 notification that Societe Generale crossed an 8.9% total voting rights threshold (8.46% direct shares, 0.44% via financial instruments) as of 13 July 2026. The filing merely discloses a passive stake crossing under UK DTR 5.8.12R and does not involve any acquisition proposal, tender offer, or special corporate action by the issuer. No board recommendation, price per share, premium, or deal mechanics are mentioned. As a routine major holdings notification, this is not a special situation event. No further action or risk-arb angle is warranted.
